caption: Old Fortress, Corfu
composition: Liston arcade and the Old Fortress across the Spianada moat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Spianada, the arcaded Liston runs along the left of the wide frame and the Old Fortress stands on its rocky promontory across the moat, with the church of St George visible inside. The sky is clear, about 19.4°C. Street lamps line the square. The fortress mass is in moonlight, not a floodlight wash.

Technical: masters at exact 1920x1080 / 864x1080 (sweep-verified); on-image caption 'Old Fortress, Corfu', scenario '24 September 2026 · 03:19 Europe/Athens', 'AI-generated artistic interpretation · Not a photograph' disclosure and exact 'Jason D's Vision' signature all legible on the bottom gradient. Gate 2 weather: note cites its own Open-Meteo fetch, retrieved 2026-09-25T21:43:54Z — repo-wide unique (verified against all 366 Greece notes), separate request for 39.6243,19.9217, scenario minute 03:19 inside the 03:15 model-valid hour, values clear/19.7°C consistent with the clear night sky shown. Gate 4: no prominent people, no focal logos. 5/5.
